sources.quote: HD 221287, named Poerava, is a star in the southern constellation of Tucana.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 1.2 solar radii and 1.14 solar masses (FLAME) and 6,162 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
